newsitem.title: USA: MaxServ may respond today to Sears.
newsitem.headline: MaxServ may respond today to Sears.

text.p: MaxServ Inc said Tuesday it expects to respond later today to a $7 a share cash tender offer it has received from Sears, Roebuck and Co for all of its shares not already held by the giant retailer.
"We received the offer from Sears. We haven't seen the full text," said Neil Johnson, MaxServ senior vice president and chief financial officer.
"The company is considering its response and expects to have an initial response this afternoon," Johnson told Reuters.

Earlier today, Sears launched a tender offer for all of the shares of MaxServ it does not already hold. Sears holds about 64.6 percent or about seven million shares of MaxServ's 10.9 million shares outstanding.
The tender was launched after negotiations broke down and a special committee of MaxServ's board of directors rejected Sears' offer.

Austin, Texas-based MaxServ provides information regarding the care, repair and usage of household products and other electronic products. It also provides telemarketing services for replacement parts.
Sears owns and operates more than 2,300 department and specialty stores in the the United States.
Shares of MaxServ were trading up 1/4 to 7-1/4. Sears shares were trading up 3/4 to 48-1/4.
